svg.aria-label: Issue #09: Dermatology Diagnosis (2024). Upload a photo of a skin lesion and get the three most likely diagnoses across seven lesion types, from benign keratosis and melanocytic nevi to melanoma and basal cell carcinoma. I built a CNN ensemble of ResNet-50, EfficientNet and YOLO, trained in PyTorch on 10K+ medical images with OpenCV preprocessing, which boosted top-1 accuracy by 12% and top-3 accuracy by 18%. The top-3 predictions are served through a FastAPI REST endpoint, containerized with Docker and deployed on AWS ECS at 99.9% uptime.
